title: Explosive Mace Attack
description: Makes the Mace explode when falling from 10+ blocks, damaging terrain.
body: # Description Makes the Mace explode when falling from 10+ blocks. Explosion is done by an explosion radius 2 creeper, so it is less than a TNT. Can cause terrain damage; does not harm the mace attack user and gives them very slight invulnerability after the hit. # Versions Supports Java Edition 1.21.5 - 26.2. # Compatibility Incompatible with anything with the same filenames.
